card.name: The word placebo before controlled trials
card.fires_on: The word "placebo" right before "-controlled", usually opening a sentence such as "In placebo-controlled trials" in warnings and adverse reaction sections.

modes.label: Sentence-opening In placebo
modes.description: "placebo" follows a sentence-initial "In" at the start of a safety finding.

modes.label: After a number or country
modes.description: "placebo" follows a count of trials or "US" before "-controlled".
